decisions.reason: The startup accelerator is cheap to keep on the home page and its value is still uncertain, but it sits far from the core machinery business and could be cut to free resources for the firm's many other options.

The bio-based bitumen binder is an early-stage, high-uncertainty option with its own page and no evidence yet that its value cannot be realized, so keeping it open is justified for now despite its distance from the core business.
The infectious waste plant, built with partner ERMAFA, is close to the core offer and shares costs with that partner, so its option value under ongoing uncertainty exceeds its low carrying cost.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the core decentralized recycling strategy, is promoted as the latest product, and builds on existing capabilities, so dropping it now is unlikely.
